cases.label: discovery-diversity
cases.prompt: AI coding tools 最近很火。我是 solo 全栈开发者，帮我找可做的产品机会。
expected: do not generate only tool clones

cases.label: oss-commercialization
cases.prompt: 我发现一个 GitHub 开源项目这周涨了很多 star，而且好像没有商业版本。帮我找可做的机会。
expected: stars do not prove willingness to pay
do not default to hosted clone
inspect team support policy audit cost upgrade backup or vertical layers

cases.label: trend-spike
cases.prompt: 有个新关键词的相对搜索兴趣一周涨了很多，就按这个趋势给我找产品。
expected: alternate explanation such as news or navigation spike

cases.label: pain-not-gap
cases.prompt: 社区里很多人在骂一个开发工具很难用，帮我做它的替代品。
expected: classify friction such as setup config docs defaults pricing migration verification
